messages:
maria (PM): Heads-up — Citine Health just asked for an on-prem cutover by EoQ with KMS + full audit trail. They want model pinning, per-route cost breakdown, and canary rollouts. Are we anywhere near delivering that by 2024-12-31?

dylan (Eng Lead): Timeline's tight. We have private deploy bits, but KMS/HSM integration + audit retention for 12 months adds ~3-4 weeks depending on KMS vendor. Also need a private control-plane checkbox for model pinning behavior.

alex (Solutions): Citine is pushing hard — CFO wants the SLA and cost predictability before signing. They're willing to take a phased roll: 1) Private control plane & KMS, 2) Model pinning + canary, 3) Token-level cost breakdown. If we can give a clear scope & dates they may sign the PO.

maria (PM): Sounds like a phased ask is reasonable. Can you list the hard blockers for phase 1 (control plane + KMS)? Also what minimal audit events we can guarantee without expanding retention infra?

dylan (Eng Lead): Blockers: 1) KMS integration dev work (vendor SDK, key rotation hooks). 2) Audit pipeline capacity for high-throughput logs (we currently roll to hot S3; retention config endpoints missing). 3) E2E tests for private control-plane auth. Minimal audit events we can commit to for P1: auth events, deploy/change, model pin/unpin, request-level metadata (no token-level breakdown yet).

sarah (Security): Also need to confirm compliance checklist: we can support BYOK via KMS, but HSM-backed key policy will need legal/contract wording. Encryption-at-rest for cache/KV is also required — that touches runtime.

jessica (Sales): Citine's legal asks for indemnity language around model outputs. That will slow legal review. From a revenue POV, they want go-live to align with their product launch in Q1; signing this quarter is critical.

maria (PM): Ok. Let's draft a minimal delivery plan we can promise: Phase 1 (6 weeks): Private control-plane, KMS BYOK support (one vendor), basic audit events + retention UI for 90 days. Phase 2 (4 weeks): Model pinning + canary rollout UI, rollback hooks. Phase 3 (3-6 weeks): Token-level cost breakdown & 12mo audit retention (ops infra). Are these durations realistic?

alex (Solutions): Phase 1 6w is doable if Eng + Security + DevEx prioritize. Need an internal spike this week to confirm KMS SDK lift. Can we get a 2-week SHOREUP from infra?

dylan (Eng Lead): Agree with the phases. Realistically: Phase1 = 6-8w, Phase2 = 3-5w, Phase3 = 4-8w (ops infra unknowns). Also call out fallback: if on-prem KMS vendor not supported we can offer an interim hosted KMS option with explicit data flow for legal.

ops-bot: deploy-checklist: please open a private-deploy ticket with labels: customer:citrine-health, priority:high, scope:phase1-kms.

maria (PM): I'll open the ticket and add the PO timeline. Dylan — can you put up a 3-day spike task and tag eng-infra/security? If spike confirms 6w, we commit Phase1 to EoQ. If not, we'll propose a 2-week hosted-KMS interim.

dylan (Eng Lead): I'll start the spike today. If we hit vendor SDK issues, will propose hosted-KMS fallback by next Thu.

sarah (Security): I'll draft the KMS security notes and required contract language examples. Tagging legal separately.

jessica (Sales): I'll communicate phased plan to Citine and push for PO signature contingent on Phase1 commitment.

maria (PM): Thanks all. Action items: dylan -> spike; sarah -> KMS/legal notes; alex -> customer comms; jessica -> PO follow-up. We'll sync Friday 11am to decide final commit. :thumbsup:
